expenseRatioNote: Yahoo Finance reports no expense ratio for XBAL.TO. This is BlackRock Canada's own published Management Expense Ratio (MER) as of December 31, 2025, from the fund's official ETF Facts document at blackrock.com/ca. The management fee was cut from 0.18% to 0.17% effective Dec 18, 2025, but that's only 13 days of the reported fiscal year, so this MER is still mostly the pre-cut rate; the lower fee should show up more fully in next year's figure.
